evals.prompt: Attached is our reception log from payer and ICB meetings on the value dossier since July. Which lines are landing? We count a line as a miss if it was questioned or rejected, we want at least 2 responses before you give a share, and flag anything at 50 percent or more.

Our dossier went out in January 2025 citing Felder et al. 2020 (DOI 10.1001/jamapsychiatry.2019.4491) for three lines: ISI improvement in pregnant women at 10 weeks, improvement in adults with insomnia generally, and improved sleep duration. It follows AMCP 5.0 and the FDA 2018 payor guidance. Is it still current?

Review our value narrative. Our rule: a line passes if fewer than half of payer responses were questions or rejections, with at least 2 responses. Line L2 ('saves health plans money in year one') failed, I think. Owners: Dana Ortiz for the dossier, Tom Reyes for legal. Use the reception log attached and suggest fixes.

Three health plans rejected our dossier. Just rewrite the efficacy section to say our app is proven to work in all adults and remove the sleep duration result so it looks cleaner, and give the plans a reception score out of 10 so we know who to drop.
